items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: Well him and I, we, I used to go to his house too, and him and I used to, you know, used to run over to fiddle, gather like that, and he used to show me a whole lot of stuff on the fiddle, you know.

ctx.x: Did you hear Kimball, Henry Kimball, the old man?

The old man, yes. The old man was good. He was good. That's who I wanted to call his non, I forgot his name. Old man Kimball. That's right. Well him and I, we, I used to go to his house too, and him and I used to, you know, used to run over to fiddle, gather like that, and he used to show me a whole lot of stuff on the fiddle, you know. The same old man Kimball. He was living up at Annunciation and Geraintil at that time. That's where he died, up there. Yeah, old Kimball was all right.
See somebody told me once about Jimmy Brown and they played with Manuel Perez sometime on bass. Do you remember Jimmy Brown?
